Body.Content:
Azure SignalR Service, now in preview, is a fully-managed service that allows developers to focus on building real-time web experiences without worrying about capacity provisioning, reliable connections, scaling, encryption, or authentication. Through tight integration with the .NET SignalR library and Visual Studio family, the service makes it easier to deliver experiences such as chat, instant broadcasting, and IoT dashboards. 

Learn more, and try the quick start.
